name: raidlead-companion
description: Desktop companion for the RaidLead WoW addon -- keeps the addon's SavedVariables and the RaidLead Docs bridge folder in sync in the background, replacing the scheduled-task/PowerShell setup. The only network access it has is checking raidlead.vercel.app/updates for a newer version and notifying you -- it never downloads or installs anything on its own.
